_comment: InnerTube client blocks in fallback order (snapshot 2026-08-22). YouTube retires client versions every few weeks: a same-named file dropped into the module's data dir replaces this one without rebuilding the module. Never add web/web_safari (SABR-only, needs the JS player), tv/tv_downgraded/web_embedded (signatureCipher) or android_vr (all formats 403 since 2026-08-17).
